Render a results table as LaTeX (booktabs + threeparttable)

Source: R/table.R
cr_latex.Rd

Produces a self-contained table float for Overleaf (\input{} it), or only the threeparttable block when float = FALSE (used inside Quarto, which supplies the float and caption). Requires \usepackage{booktabs} and \usepackage{threeparttable}; compiles with pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX, or LuaLaTeX.

Usage

cr_latex(
  x,
  caption = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  float = TRUE,
  placement = "htbp",
  size = "\\small"
)

Arguments

x

A clean_results or cr_table object.

caption, label

Caption and \label{} key (e.g. "tab:main").

float

Wrap in a table environment.

placement

Float placement specifier.

size

Font size command applied inside the float, e.g. "\\small".

Value

A character string of LaTeX code.
